title_en: From a Garage to the Top of the World
english_paragraphs: In May 1985, after a bruising confrontation, Apple's board ultimately backed chief executive John Sculley. Steve Jobs, 30, was stripped of his managerial duties at the company he had co-founded. That September, sidelined and alienated, he resigned.

Rewind three decades. Born in San Francisco on 24 February 1955, Jobs was adopted as a newborn. On 1 April 1976 he founded Apple with Steve Wozniak, the electronics engineer behind its first prototypes. Apple's garage origins are largely symbolic; Wozniak calls their significance inflated. Apple floated on 12 December 1980; the flagship Macintosh debuted on 24 January 1984.

Exile proved productive. Later in 1985 Jobs founded NeXT, a computer start-up. In February 1986 he acquired Lucasfilm's computer-graphics outfit, which became Pixar. It began as a manufacturer of specialised hardware, not chiefly an animation studio. Toy Story, released on 22 November 1995, was the first feature-length computer-animated film.

The reversal came on 20 December 1996: Apple agreed to buy NeXT, gaining the core software of the eventual Mac OS X and reuniting with its estranged co-founder. In August 1997 Microsoft invested $150 million in its distressed competitor; that September Jobs took the reins as interim chief. Apple, he later said, had been weeks from ruin. The iMac, iPod, and iPhone followed, the iPhone showcased on 9 January 2007.

In October 2003 Jobs received a diagnosis: an uncommon, cancerous pancreatic tumour. In August 2011 Apple briefly overtook Exxon Mobil as the world's most valuable company. His tenure ended on 24 August 2011; he died on 5 October 2011, aged 56. He had spent nearly fourteen years at the helm of the company that ousted him.
chinese_source_paragraphs: 1985年5月，经过一场**十分激烈的**(bruising)**争执/交锋**(confrontation)，苹果公司**董事会**(board)**最终**(ultimately)支持首席**执行官**(executive)约翰·斯卡利。时年30岁的史蒂夫·乔布斯在他参与**创办**(co-founded)的公司里被**剥夺了**(stripped of)**管理的**(managerial)职务。同年9月，已被**架空**(sidelined)、**被疏远的**(alienated)乔布斯**辞职了**(resigned)。

**回溯**(Rewind)三十年。1955年2月24日，乔布斯生于**旧金山**(San Francisco)，还是**新生儿**(newborn)时就**被收养**(adopted)。1976年4月1日，他与史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克**创办了**(founded)苹果公司；沃兹尼亚克是苹果首批**样机**(prototypes)背后的**电子**(electronics)工程师。苹果的车库**起源**(origins)在很大程度上只是具有**象征**(symbolic)意义的；沃兹尼亚克称其**意义**(significance)被**夸大了**(inflated)。1980年12月12日，苹果公司**上市**(floated)；而**旗舰**(flagship)产品 Macintosh**首次推出**(debuted)于1984年1月24号。

这段**放逐**(Exile)岁月**成果丰硕**(productive)。1985年晚些时候，乔布斯**创办了**(founded) NeXT，一家电脑**初创公司**(start-up)。1986年2月，他**收购了**(acquired)卢卡斯影业的电脑**图形**(graphics)**团队**(outfit)，这个团队后来成为**皮克斯**(Pixar)。皮克斯起初是一家**制造商**(manufacturer)，生产**专用**(specialised)**硬件**(hardware)，主要并不是**动画**(animation)**工作室**(studio)。《玩具总动员》于1995年11月22日**上映**(released)，是第一部**长篇**(feature-length)**电脑动画**(computer-animated)电影。

1996年12月20日，局面出现**彻底转变**(reversal)。苹果同意收购NeXT，从而获得了**最终版**(eventual) Mac OS X 的**核心**(core)软件，并**与**(reuniting with)**关系疏远的**(estranged)联合创始人**重聚**(reuniting with)。1997年8月，微软**向**(invested in)这个**陷入困境的**(distressed)**竞争对手**(competitor)**投资**(invested in)1.5亿美元；同年9月，乔布斯**接掌大权**(took the reins)，出任**临时**(interim)负责人。他后来说，苹果当时离**破产**(ruin)只差几周。iMac、iPod和 iPhone相继问世，iPhone于2007年1月9日公开**展示**(showcased)。

2003年10月，乔布斯收到了一份**诊断**(diagnosis)：一种**罕见的**(uncommon)**恶性**(cancerous)**胰腺**(pancreatic)**肿瘤**(tumour)。2011年8月，苹果公司**一度**(briefly)**超越**(overtook)埃克森美孚，成为全球**市值最高的**(most valuable)公司。2011年8月24日，他的**任期**(tenure)结束；2011年10月5日，他去世，终年56岁。（在他最终离开时）他已在那家曾把他**逐出**(ousted)的公司**掌舵**(at the helm of)近十四年。

sentences.english: In August 2011 Apple briefly overtook Exxon Mobil as the world's most valuable company.
sentences.chinese_source: 2011年8月，苹果公司**一度**(briefly)**超越**(overtook)埃克森美孚，成为全球**市值最高的**(most valuable)公司。

sentences.english: His tenure ended on 24 August 2011; he died on 5 October 2011, aged 56.
sentences.chinese_source: 2011年8月24日，他的**任期**(tenure)结束；2011年10月5日，他去世，终年56岁。

sentences.english: He had spent nearly fourteen years at the helm of the company that ousted him.
sentences.chinese_source: （在他最终离开时）他已在那家曾把他**逐出**(ousted)的公司**掌舵**(at the helm of)近十四年。

approved_summary: 1976年，乔布斯与沃兹尼亚克创办苹果，后者研制首批样机；苹果1980年上市，车库起源的意义被夸大。
1985年，董事会在冲突中支持首席执行官斯卡利，解除乔布斯管理职务；被架空的乔布斯随后辞职。
他创办NeXT，收购皮克斯前身；皮克斯原造专用硬件，1995年推出全球首部长篇电脑动画《玩具总动员》。
1996年苹果同意收购NeXT，获得后来Mac OS X的核心软件；次年微软向苹果注资1.5亿美元，乔布斯回归掌舵。
iMac、iPod、iPhone相继推出，苹果2011年一度市值全球第一；患胰腺恶性肿瘤的乔布斯同年卸任、去世。
